newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe Steel to form study group for int'l calls.
newsitem.headline: Kobe Steel to form study group for int'l calls.

text.p: Kobe Steel Ltd said on Tuesday that it, Global One Inc and Creative Link Corp agreed to form a study group on June 4 to conduct trials for an international call service using leased lines.
The study group will start testing the service, to be offered exclusively in the Kobe area, later this year, the company said.
The Japanese government is expected to allow companies to offer international call services through lines leased from international carriers starting in October, it said.
Last Friday, Kobe said it and Global One, a multinational telecoms venture, planned jointly to launch an international call service.
Global One Inc, set up in January 1996, is the Tokyo-based unit of Global One, a worldwide joint venture between France Telecom, Deutsche Telekom AG and Sprint Corp.

Global One has already started offering Japanese customers voice and data services, private-line and other interconnection services, and packet switching and frame relay services for local-area networks.
Tokyo-based Creative Link offers information and telecommunications services as well as Internet, education and consulting services.
After Japan's international call sector is deregulated in October, an operating company will be formed offering services exclusively in the Kobe area, a Kobe Steel spokesman said.
The company, which has no plans to offer its services nationwide, is aiming for initial sales of 1.5 billion yen a year, he said.
